spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is a real photo of No. 4 Park; image 4 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Night at No. 4 Park (823 Memorial Park) from image 3: the pond edged with rocks and willow trees, now with a fountain in the pond shooting jets of water lit in warm golden light, trees strung with small lights, apartment windows glowing beyond. By the water, the man stands facing the woman, looking at her earnestly; she covers her mouth with one hand, smiling, about to nod. Every character must be rendered as a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, with faces, glasses, hairstyles and outfits identical to their references, never as a flat 2D drawing. Mouths closed in small gentle smiles. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
